title: Nickel and Cobalt Update - Benchmark Summit 2026 London
gist: This is a member-only video page for Benchmark head of energy raw materials Adam Webb's nickel and cobalt update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London. It gives no prices, balances or forecasts. The related sessions listed cover rare earths, lithium supply, Texas Smackover lithium and the UK Critical Minerals Strategy.

insights.claim: Benchmark head of energy raw materials Adam Webb presented a nickel and cobalt market update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London on Oct 22, 2026. The page is member-only and gives no prices, balances or forecasts.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb, Head of Energy Raw Materials, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Benchmark's nickel and cobalt view is not public here, so it cannot be used to adjust positioning.
insights.locator: Nickel and Cobalt Update - Benchmark Summit 2026 London

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a fireside chat on rare earths framed as investing in strategic assets and unlocking value, which treats rare earths as a strategic-asset investment theme.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb, Head of Energy Raw Materials, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Rare earths are being pitched to investors as strategic assets, so rare-earth project financing is a theme to monitor.
insights.quote: Rare Earths - Investing in strategic assets and unlocking value

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a keynote billing the Texas Smackover as "America's Lithium Leviathan", which presents the Smackover brine as a major prospective source of US domestic lithium supply.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb, Head of Energy Raw Materials, Benchmark
insights.so_what: US brine lithium from the Smackover is being pitched as a large domestic supply source, which is worth tracking for North American lithium project developers.
insights.quote: The Texas Smackover: America's Lithium Leviathan

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a fireside chat on the UK Critical Minerals Strategy and a keynote asking whether British industry can stay competitive given unpredictable power costs, which puts UK industrial policy at the centre of the event.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb, Head of Energy Raw Materials, Benchmark
insights.so_what: UK critical-minerals policy and industrial power costs are live themes for UK-based battery and minerals projects.
insights.locator: Fireside Chat: The UK Critical Minerals Strategy
